title: Residency Credit on the Payment Plan Percentage
content:
The plan percentage of an Apartment Home Lease payment plan falls with tenure: a lease in possession for 36 full calendar months or more takes 0.04 off it, one in possession for 24 to 35 full calendar months takes 0.02 off it, and a shorter tenure takes nothing off.

Full calendar months of tenure are counted from the move-in date, as the lease record shows it, to the same day number of a later month, up to the day of signing. The credit is subtracted from the plan percentage before the percentage is applied, and the plan percentage never falls below zero.

| Full calendar months in possession on the day of signing | Taken off the plan percentage |
|---|---|
| 36 or more | 0.04 |
| 24 to 35 | 0.02 |
| 23 or fewer | nothing |

**Boundary dates (hypothetical move-in on 5 September 2022).** Signed 4 September 2024: 23 months, nothing taken off. Signed 5 September 2024: 24 months, 0.02. Signed 4 September 2025: 35 months, 0.02. Signed 5 September 2025: 36 months, 0.04.
